name: draw-text.scss
html:
// ── DrawText: per-character writing animation ──────────────────────────────
// --i          : character index (set from template)
// --char-delay : ms between each character (set from template, default 100ms)
// --offset     : ms base delay before any character starts (for sequencing)

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';

// Shadow host — inherits font/color so the animated text matches context.
:host {
  display: inline-block;
  vertical-align: baseline;
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
  text-transform: inherit;
  letter-spacing: inherit;
}

// Animated text container.
.draw-text {
  display: inline;
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
  text-transform: inherit;
  letter-spacing: inherit;
  // Per-character spans cannot kern or ligate; disable both in every state so
  // the plain (pending/done) and animated (char spans) renders share one geometry
  font-kerning: none;
  font-variant-ligatures: none;

  &__word {
    display: inline-block;
    white-space: nowrap; // keeps all chars of this word on one line — never splits mid-word
  }

  &__space {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 0.3em; // one space-width gap between words; breakable line-break point
  }

  &__char {
    display: inline-block;
    opacity: 0;
    // NO will-change here — adding it to every char span creates hundreds of GPU layers
    // and destroys mobile scroll performance. Only promote during the actual animation.
  }

  // Inline links (color:inherit keeps :visited from going browser-purple —
  // color is the only link ink :visited is allowed to change). A parent
  // pseudo-element draws the underline because native text-decoration skips
  // the inline-block word spans and otherwise paints only beneath whitespace.
  a,
  a:link,
  a:visited {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-block;
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;

    &::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      height: to-rem($space-hairline);
      background: currentColor;
      transform: scaleX(0);
      transform-origin: left center;
      transition: transform 0.35s ease 0.55s;
    }

    &:hover::after,
    &:focus-visible::after,
    &:active::after {
      transform: scaleX(1);
    }
  }

  // Replay the letter draw when the link is interacted with; the underline
  // follows via the delayed text-decoration-color transition above.
  // Word spans are targeted (not __char) because the done state collapses
  // chars back into plain word text — words exist in both render modes.
  a:hover .draw-text__word,
  a:focus-visible .draw-text__word,
  a:active .draw-text__word {
    animation: link-word-draw 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;
    animation-delay: calc(var(--wi, 0) * var(--word-delay, 100ms) * 0.3);
  }
}

// Buttons may host DrawText outside this shadow root (the nav logo). Treat an
// interactive parent exactly like an inline anchor: replay persistent word
// wrappers first; the parent's own delayed underline follows afterwards.
:host-context(button:hover) .draw-text__word,
:host-context(button:focus-visible) .draw-text__word,
:host-context(button:active) .draw-text__word {
  animation: link-word-draw 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--wi, 0) * var(--word-delay, 100ms) * 0.3);
}

// Link hover redraw: a subtler, quicker version of char-draw — a soft
// opacity dip + small rise, no blur (cheap to replay on every interaction).
@keyframes link-word-draw {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(0.06em);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}

// ── Section titles: animate on mount (replayed via :key re-mount) ──────────
.home-section-title .draw-text__char {
  will-change: opacity, transform; // promote only during animation
  animation: char-draw 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--offset, 0ms) + var(--i, 0) * var(--char-delay, 100ms));
}

// ── Inside slides: animate only when the slide becomes active ──────────────
.aw-c-slide--active .draw-text__char {
  will-change: opacity, transform;
  animation: char-draw 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--offset, 0ms) + var(--i, 0) * var(--char-delay, 100ms));
}

// ── Viewport trigger: animate when scrolled into view ──────────────────────
// .draw-text--visible is added by IntersectionObserver in the component
.draw-text--visible .draw-text__char {
  will-change: opacity, transform;
  animation: char-draw 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--offset, 0ms) + var(--i, 0) * var(--char-delay, 100ms));
}

// Waiting for the viewport trigger: words rendered as plain nodes, kept invisible
.draw-text--pending {
  opacity: 0;
}

// Frozen state: animation complete, chars permanently visible, no re-trigger possible
.draw-text--done .draw-text__char {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
  filter: none;
  animation: none;
  will-change: auto; // release GPU layer after animation is done
}

// ── Related Mosaic: animate write effect ─────────────────────────────────────
.related-mosaic-desc .draw-text__char {
  will-change: opacity, transform;
  animation: char-draw 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--offset, 0ms) + var(--i, 0) * var(--char-delay, 15ms));
}

// ── Character draw keyframes ────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Desktop: full effect with blur + scale
@keyframes char-draw {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(0.12em) scaleY(0.3);
    filter: blur(3px);
  }
  30% {
    opacity: 0.5;
    transform: translateY(0.04em) scaleY(0.85);
    filter: blur(1px);
  }
  60% {
    opacity: 0.85;
    transform: translateY(0.01em) scaleY(0.97);
    filter: blur(0);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
    filter: none;
  }
}

// Mobile: no filter:blur (extremely expensive on mobile GPUs), no scaleY
// Keep only opacity + small translateY for a light, performant fade-in effect
@media (max-width: 960px) {
  @keyframes char-draw {
    0% {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(0.1em);
    }
    100% {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: none;
    }
  }

  // NO per-character will-change on mobile.
  // Creating a compositor layer for every character span (potentially 200+) simultaneously
  // overwhelms the mobile GPU and freezes scroll. CSS transform/opacity animations are
  // automatically GPU-composited by mobile browsers without an explicit hint.
  // The browser promotes layers on demand as characters become active — far cheaper.
  .draw-text--visible .draw-text__char,
  .home-section-title .draw-text__char,
  .aw-c-slide--active .draw-text__char,
  .related-mosaic-desc .draw-text__char {
    will-change: auto;
  }
}

// ── Word-level animation on small screens (≤768px) ──────────────────────────
// Root cause of mobile freeze: per-character animation creates 100–300+
// simultaneous CSS animations (one per span). Mobile browsers cannot schedule
// that many compositor operations without dropping frames.
//
// Fix: animate the .draw-text__word wrapper instead of each char.
// JS sets --wi (word index) and --word-delay on every word span.
// Result: ~10–20 word animations instead of ~200+ char animations.
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  @keyframes word-draw {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(0.08em);
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: none;
    }
  }

  // Word-level stagger replaces char-level stagger
  .draw-text--visible .draw-text__word,
  .home-section-title .draw-text__word,
  .aw-c-slide--active .draw-text__word,
  .related-mosaic-desc .draw-text__word {
    opacity: 0;
    animation: word-draw 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
    animation-delay: calc(var(--offset, 0ms) + var(--wi, 0) * var(--word-delay, 100ms));
  }

  // Chars inside animated words are immediately visible — word wrapper handles the fade
  .draw-text--visible .draw-text__char,
  .home-section-title .draw-text__char,
  .aw-c-slide--active .draw-text__char,
  .related-mosaic-desc .draw-text__char {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
    animation: none;
    will-change: auto;
  }

  // Done state: release word GPU layers once animation is complete
  .draw-text--done .draw-text__word {
    opacity: 1;
    animation: none;
    will-change: auto;
  }
}

// ── Liquid warp (draw-text[warp]) ─────────────────────────────────────────
// Chars keep their spans after the reveal; inline transforms are written by
// JS per pointer frame. This transition is what makes it liquid: the short
// ease smooths each write and the --i-scaled delay lets the wave trail the
// cursor instead of snapping in unison. Only in --done (post-reveal), so it
// never fights the char-draw keyframes.
.draw-text--warp.draw-text--done .draw-text__char {
  transition: transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  transition-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 12ms);
  transform-origin: center bottom;
}

// ── Reduced Motion Override ────────────────────────────────────────────────
:host-context(html.reduced-motion) .draw-text__char,
:host-context(html.reduced-motion) .draw-text a:hover .draw-text__word,
:host-context(html.reduced-motion) .draw-text a:focus-visible .draw-text__word,
:host-context(html.reduced-motion) .draw-text a:active .draw-text__word,
:host-context(html.reduced-motion) .draw-text__word {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
  filter: none;
  animation: none;
}

:host-context(html.reduced-motion) .draw-text a::after {
  transition-delay: 0s;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .draw-text__char,
  .draw-text a:hover .draw-text__word,
  .draw-text a:focus-visible .draw-text__word,
  .draw-text a:active .draw-text__word,
  :host-context(button:hover) .draw-text__word,
  :host-context(button:focus-visible) .draw-text__word,
  :host-context(button:active) .draw-text__word {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
    filter: none;
    animation: none;
  }

  .draw-text a::after {
    transition-delay: 0s;
  }
}

// Keyboard focus ring on this shadow root's tabbable elements — the file
// doesn't import _structure (which emits it globally), so include the
// shared scope explicitly.
@include focus-ring-scope;
